CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   C. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   B. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self-control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Thoughts and feelings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
